header.name: Sohayb Hassan
header.title: Full-Stack Engineer · Java / Spring Boot · React · Banking & Financial Services

summary: Full-stack engineer with six years at Capgemini building backend and web systems for banks, insurers and corporate clients. Currently delivers features end to end on a retail bank's mobile platform: Java 17 / Spring Boot 3 microservices, an OpenAPI-first BFF layer on JDK 21 and the React Native app. At home with the unglamorous side of banking integration (legacy hosts, BPM processes, multi-environment release pipelines) and with the tooling that keeps a large multi-repository programme moving. Started out migrating COBOL to Spring Boot; now spends personal time on LLM-assisted modernisation tooling where the output is verified, not trusted.

blocks.title: Mobile banking platform — major Italian retail banking group
bullets: Deliver features end to end across all three layers: Java 17 / Spring Boot 3 microservices, an OpenAPI-first BFF on JDK 21 and the React Native / Redux Toolkit app.
Design and build new banking product flows and REST APIs, from the OpenAPI contract through the BFF and microservice to the app state, including hand-offs to the bank's BPM processes.
Integrate legacy banking systems over SOAP and REST — payments, cards, limits and document processing — with the error handling that keeps the app usable when a host misbehaves.

Caching, resilience and observability in production (Hazelcast, Resilience4j, Micrometer/Prometheus, Splunk, Dynatrace); Kubernetes deployments through Azure DevOps release pipelines across multiple environments.

Built the team's internal tooling: environment and API-collection generators, git guard hooks, end-to-end test harnesses, an LLM-assisted agent workflow with a regression suite, and the engineering handbook.
Mentor junior developers and run knowledge-transfer sessions on Spring Boot and React practice.

blocks.title: Digital HR platform — corporate group
bullets: Built the employee-facing web platform in React + TypeScript on SharePoint Framework, from Figma prototypes to production; REST integration with the HR back end; Azure DevOps CI/CD set up together with the DevOps team.

experience.subtitle: Media, insurance and oil & gas clients

bullets: Advertising segmentation tool for a German pay-TV broadcaster: React front end for audience targeting, Akka-based microservices and Elasticsearch for real-time segmentation; Mocha/Chai tests, releases through UAT to production.
Oil & gas client: Spring Boot services on Hibernate/PostgreSQL feeding Angular.js dashboards; tuned the data pipeline behind them.
Migrated a legacy COBOL policy-listing system to Java Spring Boot services (Hibernate/JDBC on PostgreSQL) consumed by an Angular.js front end; kept the Maven/Git CI running for the team.
React + TypeScript / Node.js MVP for an agri-tech client, built end to end in a team of four.

projects.title: LLM-assisted legacy modernisation
projects.summary: COBOL to Spring Boot with differential-execution verification of the generated code: the referee that proves equivalence is built before the agent that writes the code. Personal project.

projects.title: Engineering-workflow automation
projects.summary: For the banking programme above: LLM agents and skills wired to git hooks, an approval gate and a regression suite, so the assistant follows the team's branch and review rules instead of bypassing them.
